title: Mandatory structured security event emission
objective: Governed APIs, Strata persistence, agent runtimes and infrastructure emit catalog-defined security events with actor, authority, action, resource, decision, result, correlation id and policy version; missing emission fails tests.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Append-only, independently verifiable audit history
objective: Audit and security logs are append-only below the application layer, stored in a separate trust domain, protected from Echelon administrators, and verified by hash chains or signed checkpoints.
implementing_systems: Strata (candidate persistence; tamper-evidence capabilities not verified)
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Privacy-aware logging and classified retention
objective: Secrets, credentials, full account numbers and unnecessary personal data are excluded at emission by typed log schemas; retention is set per log class with legal hold and lawful deletion support.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Centralized analysis, alerting and protective response
objective: Security events flow to a central analysis platform; high-severity alerts page an on-call responder at any hour and can trigger pre-approved protective actions (account disablement, payment hold under CNV-PLT-007).
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Tested detection engineering
objective: Detections are versioned code mapped to threats, tested with seeded events on every change and periodically, with false positive rates tracked.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Tenant-scoped customer audit trail with independent verification
objective: Customers can view, export and stream their tenant's audit events, including Echelon personnel and break-glass actions, with integrity proofs verifiable outside Echelon systems.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Missing-evidence and heartbeat detection
objective: An independent expectation engine raises a monitored deficiency for any missing or late log source or control heartbeat; monitoring failure is a degraded-assurance incident with defined fail-closed behavior for consequential actions.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Attributable AI agent activity logging and scope enforcement
objective: Every agent action is logged with agent identity and authorizing principal; out-of-scope tool calls are denied, logged and alerted; agents can be interrupted.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Authoritative time synchronization with drift alerting
objective: All log-producing components synchronize to authoritative time sources; offsets are measured and alerted; records carry occurredAt and recordedAt in UTC.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Privileged, break-glass and pipeline activity monitoring
objective: Break-glass uses sealed credentials with two-person activation, auto-expiry, paging and tenant notification; privileged sessions and CI or deployment configuration changes are recorded and reviewed.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)
